notablePrerequisites:
You have not played a land this turn.
You control at least six differently named lands.
description:
If Oboro is on the battlefield, tap it for {U}.
Activate Oboro for {U}, returning it to your hand.
Play Oboro.
Field of the Dead and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, not putting anything onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
In response to the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, tap Oboro for {U}.
Activate Oboro, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Oboro onto the battlefield from your hand.
Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 7.
